name: Obtaining Wealth
overview: Scripture teaches that obtaining wealth is ultimately empowered by the Lord, who grants the ability to gain riches as part of His covenant faithfulness (Deuteronomy 8:18). Diligence and honest labor are emphasized as means to increase wealth, while reliance on laziness or vanity leads to loss (Proverbs 10:4; 13:11). Importantly, wealth itself is not the source of security or deliverance; rather, righteousness is what truly protects and sustains a person, warning against placing trust in riches alone (Proverbs 11:4, 28). The blessing of the Lord enriches without bringing sorrow, highlighting that true prosperity is a gracious gift from God (Proverbs 10:22).
